Doulat Khatri vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 December,
2021
Author: Anjuli Palo

Bench: Anjuli Palo
 1 Crr-3374-2021
 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 Crr No. 3374 of 2021
(Doulat Khatri Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) Jabalpur, Dated : 16-12-2021

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 Crr No. 3374 of 2021
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri S.S. Thakur, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Pankaj Tiwari, learned Panel Lawyer for the State.
This revision seems to be arguable, therefore, admitted for hearing.
Record of the Courts below be requisitioned.
Also heard on I.A. No.22188/2021, which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.

The applicant has been convicted under Section 7(1) read with Section 16(1)(A)(l) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to S.I. for six months with fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that fine amount has already been deposited by the applicant.
Disposal of this revision would take considerable time, hence, the jail sentence of the applicant be suspended and he be released on bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the nature of offence and period of jail sentence awarded to the applicant, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.35,000/-(Rupees Thirty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court 2 CRR-3374-2021 concerned, remaining jail sentence imposed upon applicant - Doulat Khatri shall remain suspended during the pendency of this case and he shall be released on bail.
The applicant shall appear before the trial Court concerned on 05.04.2022 and on all such subsequent dates, as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of this revision.
List this case for final hearing in due course.
